description: A Python script implementing a Streamlit-based chatbot that integrates with language models (OpenAI and Gemini) to generate SQL queries and answers based on a database schema, with cost tracking and user interaction.

methods.name: generate_prompt
methods.description: Creates a prompt combining user question and additional instructions for the language model.

methods.name: openai_model
methods.description: Sends a prompt to the OpenAI API and returns the response.

methods.name: get_query
methods.description: Extracts SQL query enclosed within ```sql ... ``` from model output.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Executes a SQL query against the database and returns fetched rows.

methods.name: generate_final_prompt
methods.description: Creates a comprehensive prompt for answer generation based on question, SQL, data, and table info.

methods.name: get_text_content
methods.description: Extracts text content from Gemini model response object.

methods.name: cost_counter
methods.description: Calculates total token-based cost for query and answer model responses.
